title: 第二十一章 战斗模拟第二十二章 疯狂的研究速度
slug: 从巫师学徒到万界征服者
content_zh:
这正是【真理秘瞳】的另一项强大功能——战斗模拟。
只需消耗少量精神力，外挂便可以在意识中创造近乎真实的战斗场景，生成各种怪物，进行真实度极高的模拟对战。
这是用最小的代价，换取最宝贵的生存经验。
并不需要在现实世界冒着生命危险挑战那些恐怖的怪物，便可快速积攒战斗经验，熟悉不同怪物的攻击模式，寻找自己的应对之道。
这也是他为七天后的第二次全体考核所做的准备之一。
此刻。
莫宁盯着眼前那只仿佛被时光封印的、一动不动的怪物，忍不住抱怨道：
“硬甲食人魔就算了，居然还是拥有双天赋的食人魔，这也太过分了吧？”
所谓的“硬甲食人魔”，可以理解为食人魔中的变异“品种”。
或者说——精英怪。
普通食人魔没有铠甲，体表那层厚厚的土黄色或黑色皮肤，就是它们唯一的防御。
而硬甲食人魔的身体发生了某种变异——它们的体表腺体能够分泌一种特殊的粘液。
它们会将泥土涂抹在身上，与粘液混合，待其变干硬化，便形成一层天然的盔甲。
盔甲的硬度，不比石头差多少。
普通刀剑砍上去，只能留下一道白印。
更可怕的是，硬甲食人魔的体魄也比普通食人魔强了一大截。
同样的伤势，普通食人魔可能倒下，硬甲食人魔却能继续咆哮着冲过来。
硬甲食人魔的数量，比普通食人魔少得多。
根据莫宁的了解，大约五十只普通食人魔里，才会诞生一只硬甲食人魔。
即便是二级学徒，正面对上一只硬甲食人魔，想要杀死对方也要费一番力气。

倘若是掌握巫术数量较少的一级学徒，除非携带了巫术道具，否则只能落荒而逃。
而【真理秘瞳】模拟的硬甲食人魔，居然还拥有罕见的“自愈天赋”和“精神震慑天赋”。
像这样的食人魔，一百万只里未必找得出一只。
所以莫宁觉得，【真理秘瞳】太过分了。
一行行文字如流水般闪过，给出了解释：
“根据现有信息，学院安排的考核难度严重偏高，超过了92.5%的新人的能力范围。
“分析结果显示，有99.85%的概率，是考察新人应对危机的能力，还有67.92%的概率，是利用考核激发新人潜力。
“基于以上数据，考核中出现双天赋硬甲食人魔的概率为0.24%。
“根据模拟要求，怪物种类、天赋采用‘随机抽取’的模式，此次随机运算选中了双天赋硬甲食人魔。”
莫宁的嘴角又抽了一下。
0.24%？
出现概率只有千分之二点四的怪物，你居然放在模拟考核里？
故意玩我是吧？
莫宁正要开口反驳，【真理秘瞳】给出了更多解释：
content_en:
This is another powerful function of [Secret Eye of Truth] - combat simulation.
By consuming only a small amount of mental energy, the plug-in can create nearly real battle scenes in the mind, generate various monsters, and conduct highly realistic simulated battles.
This is to exchange for the most valuable survival experience at the smallest cost.
There is no need to risk your life to challenge those terrifying monsters in the real world, you can quickly accumulate combat experience, become familiar with the attack modes of different monsters, and find your own way to deal with them.
This is also one of his preparations for the second overall assessment seven days later.
now.
Mourning stared at the motionless monster in front of him that seemed to be sealed by time, and couldn't help complaining:
"Forget about being a hard-armored ogre, you're still an ogre with dual talents. Isn't this too much?"
The so-called "hard-armored ogres" can be understood as mutant "breeds" of ogres.
In other words - elite monsters.
Ordinary ogres have no armor, and the thick layer of khaki or black skin on their body is their only defense.
The bodies of the hard-armored ogres have undergone some kind of mutation - their surface glands can secrete a special kind of mucus.
They smear mud on their bodies, mix it with mucus, and when it dries and hardens, it forms a natural armor.
The hardness of armor is not much worse than stone.
An ordinary sword would only leave a white mark when struck.
What's even more frightening is that the hard-armored ogre's body is much stronger than that of ordinary ogres.
With the same injury, an ordinary ogre might fall, but a hard-armored ogre could continue to roar and rush over.
The number of hard-armored ogres is much smaller than that of ordinary ogres.
According to Mourning's understanding, only one hard-armored ogre will be born out of about fifty ordinary ogres.
Even as a second-level apprentice, if he were to face a hard-armored ogre, it would take a lot of effort to kill him.
If you are a first-level apprentice who has a small number of witchcraft skills, you will have no choice but to run away unless you carry witchcraft props.
The hard-armored ogre simulated by [Secret Eye of Truth] actually has the rare "self-healing talent" and "mental shock talent".
You may not find one ogre like this in a million.
So Mourning felt that [Secret Eye of Truth] was too much.
Lines of text flashed by like running water, giving an explanation:
"According to the available information, the difficulty of the assessment arranged by the college is seriously high, exceeding the ability range of 92.5% of newcomers.
"The analysis results show that there is a 99.85% probability that it is to examine the ability of new people to deal with crises, and there is a 67.92% probability that it is to use assessment to stimulate the potential of new people.
"Based on the above data, the probability of a double-talented hard-armored ogre appearing in the assessment is 0.24%.
"According to the simulation requirements, the monster types and talents adopt the 'random extraction' mode. This random operation selected the dual-talent Hard Armor Ogre. "
The corner of Mourning's mouth twitched again.
0.24%?
A monster whose appearance probability is only 2.4% per thousand, and you actually put it in a simulation assessment?
Are you playing with me on purpose?
Mourning was about to retort when [Secret Eye of Truth] gave more explanation:
